description: Create or replace the project's Intent document in the owner's own words: a short markdown document with the sections Purpose, Invariants (NEVER and ALWAYS sentences the guard will enforce), Decisions (with the why), and Out of scope. Every session loads it, the end-of-turn review checks changes against it, and every replacement is versioned. Use it when the owner describes what the project is for, or agrees to record a change of intent. Ask before replacing an existing document, and pass changed_by "agent" when you drafted the text.

changed_by.description: user = the owner wrote or approved these exact words; agent = the assistant drafted them

content.description: The full intent document (markdown, at most 8000 characters). This replaces the previous version; the previous text is kept as a version.

project_id.description: Project identifier override (auto-detected from CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR or git remote if omitted)

name: set_intent
